_doc: Dark Knight line (spec #348, ticket D2 #350). Skills are defined here by D5-D9 (spec #348). Skill keys a job names before they are defined stay inert: undefined skills are never offered or learned. Power Strike and Slash Blast stay in skills/hero.json (DK-13): never define them here.

spear_crusher._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1311001 at its eight mapped levels (4 8 12 15 23 25 27 30): damage 70 to 170 %, attackCount 2 (levels 1-15) or 3 (16-30), mobCount 1 to 3, the box lt (-130,-50) growing to (-150,-70) with rb (-16,0) (a 16 px dead zone in front of the knight), the per-level body action (burster1 for two hits, burster2 for three), the wings (effect) and rune rings (effect0), the K-th dragon thrust (effect1..3), hit/0 and the Use sound; the pole arm twin 1311002 has identical numbers and nodes. Tier B: effectK is the K-th thrust (D1 contact sheet; the blank wait of effect1/2/3 is 600/750/900 ms, the body's thrusts land there). Tier C: the explicit ranks table (DK-7: the default level-30 table lands rank 5 on level 19, where mobCount falls back to 1, so the rank would deal less than rank 4), the 0.6 s cooldown, the nearest-target admission (min_targets 1), the bonuses, a Final Attack hit also showing its thrust. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.70.
spear_crusher.name: Spear Crusher
spear_crusher.desc: Thrust your spear into the monsters in front of you, two or three times.

text.desc: Thrust your weapon into the monsters in front of you.

rush_dark_knight._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1321003 (Dark Knight's Rush, D1 #349): the same level table as Hero's 1121006 at every level (rank 1 = WZ level 4: damage 78 %, mobCount 15, box lt (-170,-50) rb (0,0); rank 8 = level 30: 130 %, (-250,-50)); the body action `rush` (the node's own `action`; Hero's node says rush2); effect/1..6 and effect0 dust, the Use sound through the UOL. Tier C: the 2.0 s cooldown, the always-on 80 px knock-back in the dash direction, hold-to-repeat, no start while climbing, no orb, the bot dashes away from a mob within 60 px at most every 3 s: copied from Hero's Rush (#356, spec #348 DK-14).
rush_dark_knight.name: Rush
rush_dark_knight.desc: Press the skill key with an arrow key to charge that way, damaging and shoving every monster in your path. Hold to repeat.

text.desc: Press the Rush key with an arrow key to charge that way, damaging and knocking back the monsters in your path. Hold the key to keep charging.

monster_magnet_dark_knight._rarity: tier C: Hero's Magnet bonuses copied (#356, spec #348 DK-14): Rare reach x1.2 (the `range` modifier), Epic Bigger Grab +2 targets, Unique Booster cooldown x0.75, Legendary Booster plus +2 targets (sharing the Unique's id and repeat counter). Repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 7.70.
monster_magnet_dark_knight._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1321001 (D1 #349): range 200 to 400 px, prop (pull chance 48 to 95 %), mobCount 6 (equal to Hero's 1121001 in every level row), the 18-frame effect (the same horseshoe art as Hero's Magnet) and the Use sound through the UOL. Tier C: no damage (the node has none); pulling is the shared `pull` block (7.35); the alert2 action (the node names none), the 4 s cooldown (Hero's tuned value, #346), the three-mob admission gate (`cast.min_targets`) and the 0.6 s action hold. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.70.
monster_magnet_dark_knight.name: Monster Magnet
monster_magnet_dark_knight.desc: Drags the monsters around you toward you.

text.desc: Drag distant monsters toward you, into reach of your other skills. Needs 3 monsters in range.
